qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Contractual fund lockups provide multi-year fee visibility, but mid-market PE is crowded with hundreds of competing sponsors. Lacks pricing power to increase base fee margins above inflation without conceding LP co-investment rights or fee discounts; sub-hurdle statutory ROIC (~4-10%).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Mid-market private equity and credit sponsor lacking differentiated pricing power or an unassailable moat. Highly substitutable by global and regional peers, with statutory ROIC falling short of the 12% cycle hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Bridgepoint operates mid-market buyout and private credit strategies with €39B-€58B in fee-paying AUM following the ECP acquisition. Statutory ROIC has historically ranged between 3% and 10% (ROCE 4-7%). While long-dated closed-end fund structures provide multi-year fee visibility, mid-market fund management is subject to intense LP fee pushback, co-investment concessions, and cyclical realization/performance fee volatility.
